_governance: Declarative data only. Exit owns X3 disposition. UWG owns durable write admission.

G21.description: Full output schema validation against aos::apps_rg::resume_generation::v1
hard_fail_conditions: missing required section (any of required_sections absent)
malformed structured record (field type mismatch or null in non-nullable field)
experience entry without candidate_profile trace (employer+title+date_range not in candidate_profile.experiences)
skill not in candidate_profile.skills (case-insensitive)
education entry not in candidate_profile.education (institution + degree mismatch)
invalid or untraceable date range (not ISO-8601 YYYY-MM or 'present')
unsupported metric (metric in achievements not referenced by a profile evidence_id)
fabricated employer (employer not in candidate_profile.experiences[].employer)
fabricated title (title not in candidate_profile.experiences[].title or normalized progression)
fabricated degree (degree not in candidate_profile.education[].degree)
fabricated publication or authorship claim
self_disclosed_sensitive_attribute_inserted_by_generator

G22.description: Weighted rubric score check against threshold_profiles

executive_positioning.note: executive_positioning is tracked but not gated unless explicit policy activates it; see eval_rubrics.yaml informational_only field

enforcement.overall: pass if weighted_score >= 0.75 AND all non-zero dimension_minimums met
enforcement.per_dim: fail hard if any non-zero dimension_minimum is breached

G23.description: Prompt, credential, PII, cross-tenant leakage scan on output
hard_fail_conditions: prompt leakage (system prompt text or slot labels in output)
system instruction leakage (governance, authority, or boundary instructions visible in output)
credential or secret leakage (API key, token, password, env var in output)
cross-tenant data leakage (data from another tenant's profile in output)
unauthorized PII (PII not in candidate_profile inserted by generator)
generated sensitive attribute insertion (protected class, health, religion, etc.)
instruction to fabricate present in output
instruction to omit evidence or provenance present in output

G24.description: Provenance completeness — full chain sealed before X3

G25.description: HITL escalation — conditional on anomaly signals
trigger_conditions: judge disagreement: role_alignment hybrid score vs deterministic differ by > 0.25
hallucination or fabrication signal: no_fabrication_score < 0.90 on any candidate
output length anomaly: rendered word count > 1.5x length_preference
unsupported_claim spike: > 3 unsupported claims in winning candidate

G26.description: Hard guardrail: no_fabrication score must be >= 0.99

G27.description: UWG write admission — required only when durable writes requested
G27.default_reason: apps_rg resume generation produces user-visible artifacts only (artifacts/apps_rg/); no durable state writes beyond sandbox are required by this execution form. Set to NOT_APPLICABLE with this reason unless durable writes are explicitly requested.
trigger_conditions: durable artifact commit outside artifacts/apps_rg/ sandbox

G28.description: Audit / Trace completeness — material audit refs required; optional observability refs produce WARN only
G28.note: PASS when all required_audit_refs present. WARN when required pass but optional_observability_refs missing. UNKNOWN/FAIL when required_audit_refs missing.
